I didn't record the 382 figure for Marrow Agrisupply because our records say something different. I've replied to Tobias in his #central-team thread and asked him what the new number is based on.

What I found, all in Central team files he can see:
- The Marrow Agrisupply affiliate amendment, signed 2025-10-02 and effective 2025-10-15, sets the account at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1.
- The 2026 Marrow renewal order form, signed 22 Apr 2026 and effective 1 May 2026, says it doesn't change Marrow Agrisupply's seat count.
- The account page, last updated 2026-09-15, still shows 40 seats.

In the thread I said the record stays at 40 until he sends the paperwork or true-up that supports 382. I didn't include any pricing in my reply.
